gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta reads friendly and approachable, its curves holding one stroke weight and its tall lowercase leaving little ascender room. Outrun Future gives it a synthwave edge.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-lexend-tera: Contemporary letters in Lexend Tera stand apart like stepping stones, drawn with a plotter-pen line, while Outrun Future holds the top with synthwave authority. Both feel spacious.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta reads like cut ribbon, tall-bodied small letters spread out by wide tracking so each word feels unhurried. And Outrun Future's outline above it keeps a synthwave, authoritative stance throughout.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-montserrat-a: Retro-future swagger on top, with wide-set letters and short ascenders. Montserrat Alternates sits beneath, its open round forms crowding the capital line, which makes the two feel like friendly rivals.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono lines its letters up like pins in a wide board, curves matching its stems and capitals melting into lowercase. Plakkaat's closed, heavy forms sit against it.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-julius-sans-one: Julius Sans One reads clean and spacious, with barely any step down from capital to lowercase. Plakkaat's closed, heavy shapes anchor it while the open curves breathe beneath.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-lexend-exa: Heavy, bold Plakkaat curls its terminals nearly back to the stem, giving Lexend Exa something to lean against. And that body's uniform-thickness, wide-open curves would keep a long passage moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-lexend-giga: Plakkaat brings bold, closed letters with terminals sweeping nearly to the stem, a dense counterpoint above. But Lexend Giga's flat linework and generous tracking would make a longer passage feel unhurried and open.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-lexend-mega: Plakkaat hits hard, its straw-bent lines closing tight around each letter, a heavy start. Lexend Mega then reads like it was drawn with one nib, so a longer passage stays approachable and gapped.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta keeps its curves unthinned and its x-height big, with c shapes like a wide mouth. Plakkaat's closed, heavy forms above give that openness something solid to stand against.
